scene_summary: A faceless black quilted puffer hood with two glowing red star-glint eyes sits in the central recessed niche of a pale grey plaster wall. Below it, a wall of stacked black puffer cushions is laced with speckled drawcords, toggles, and draped cord swags, and the hood's own drawstrings hang over the top cushion.
usable_surfaces: black hood void with red eye glints
draped cord swags and cord locks

detected_objects.label: Two ember-red four-point star glints in the black hood void
detected_objects.visual_evidence: Two small, sharp red four-point star highlights sit side by side at roughly the same height inside the pure black opening of the quilted hood. Each has short horizontal and vertical flare arms around a bright red core, matching the planned eye glints.
